description: Paid $0.05 per call: only the Indonesian articles newer than your cursor (?since ISO 8601), each with stable id, entities and an auditable sentiment score, plus the next cursor so a polling agent never re-pays for repeats. Pass lang="en" for English-language coverage of Indonesia (entities only, no sentiment score).

lang.description: id = Bahasa Indonesia (default), en = English-language coverage of Indonesia.

since.description: ISO 8601 timestamp; only newer articles are returned. Omit for the latest batch.

name: indonesia_feed
